mechanics.claim: Portal Jump resets Zoe's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Portal Jump {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Zoe's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: Zoe becomes unable to act briefly after casting and again after blinking back, which delays her next actions.
mechanics.quote: '''Zoe''' {{tt|briefly|See notes}} becomes {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} after casting Portal Jump as well as after blinking back.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts only after the full effect (blink out and back) completes, not on cast.
While at the blink destination, Zoe's movement speed is set to 0 but she can still perform other actions such as attacking or casting spells.
mechanics.quote: '''Zoe''' is able to perform any action while at the blink destination, except practically being unable to move through normal movement due to having 0 movement speed.
